status: Whole-model review after first 48-question scientific pass
source_basis: Historical question/system calculator mappings from the supplied newer form, supplied question/evidence audits, historical questionnaire explanation material and the five scientific review batches completed in this project.
important_source_reconciliation: The supplied newer-form text currently exposes Q46/Q47 differently from the user's later stated Q46/Q47/Q48 mapping. The user-defined mapping should be treated as the intended target, but the form/text-code artefacts need reconciliation before implementation.
headline_conclusion: The nine historical systems should be retained as a continuity layer, but questions should no longer be forced to act only as binary inputs to those nine scores.
question_count_recommendation: Do not force 50 or 52 yet. First rebuild the construct set, remove/split weak or double-barrelled items, then count the resulting instrument. A 52-question design is acceptable if it emerges naturally and adds measurement value.

architecture.name: Goals / Outcomes
architecture.purpose: Top lifestyle outcomes such as sleep, energy, fitness, healthy weight and other validated goals

architecture.name: Symptoms & behaviours
architecture.purpose: The questionnaire answers, with explicit construct type

architecture.name: Nine functional domains
architecture.purpose: Modernised versions of the historical nine body-system domains

architecture.name: Cross-domain signals
architecture.purpose: Sleep, stress, energy, diet quality, activity, resilience and other constructs that legitimately cross systems

architecture.name: Safety / constraints
architecture.purpose: Medical treatment, chronic conditions, allergies, sensitivities and other recommendation restrictions

architecture.name: Recommendation matching
architecture.purpose: Foods, bioactives and products matched to goals + signals + constraints + evidence

system_assessment.assessment: Strong domain, but reduce broad proxy mappings and separate eating-time from post-meal responses.
Useful gut/intestinal domain. Avoid equating yeast/fungus or generic symptoms with microbiome imbalance.
Strong domain. Lifestyle exposures and symptoms need different treatment from disease claims.

system_assessment.proposed_2026_name: Rename/reframe as Mind, Stress & Cognitive Function
system_assessment.assessment: Historical construct is coherent, but current terminology is dated and mixes cognition, sleep and stress.
Use illness frequency, susceptibility and recovery as distinct constructs. Do not infer immune deficiency.
Good fit, with persistent/recurrent symptom and environmental exposure distinctions.
Needs tighter question membership, especially around nocturia and Q46/Q47/Q48 numbering reconciliation.
Credible working interpretation, but not a measure of hormone levels or endocrine disease.
Strong modern fit; separate muscle symptoms, joint symptoms, mobility and activity.
